title: Adam Molded from the Bones of the Watchers' Children
description: The fallen Watchers (rational truths that descended through self-desire) are bound by four angels, but the abortions come down a second time and from this descent Adam and Eve are begotten — the natural man molded out of residue that survives even the binding of its parents, carrying structural good (bones) stamped now into the proprium. The same drama lived inwardly: Sin rooted in the body with the Old Man as rider, until the Mind of Light is fashioned within like a tree rooted in its place.
